data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'Munaa' meaning 'to adorn' or 'to honor'. In Islamic tradition, Muneeza is a beautiful name given to girls, symbolizing the idea of being cherished, esteemed, and graced. The name Muneeza carries the meaning “Adorned, Honored” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muneeza usually hope their child will grow to embody adorned, honored and live with faith, good character and purpose.
